identity.fantasy: An earthbender who keeps an Earthshaping state alive through Seismic choices, then turns stone-spam and aligned procs into lances, landslides, eruptions, and golem bursts.
identity.one_line: An earth caster that uses shared-cooldown Seismic choices, builds Earthshaping and Geomolding, and spends them on Terrasurge, Lithic Lance, Eruption, and Golem Form. Current players describe simple basic casting but meaningful proc alignment, strong single target, and less impressive AoE in mid-level gear.

mechanics.core_loop: Maintain Earthshaping by choosing the appropriate shared-cooldown Seismic spell, cast rapid Stoneshards while waiting for Crag and related procs, then spend aligned windows on Lithic Lance, Terrasurge, Golem Form, or later Eruption and Geomolding.

modes.name: Golem Form

mechanics.single_target: Current players describe very fast Stoneshard casting with Earthshaping refreshes, then high burst when Lithic Lance and landslide-style procs align.
mechanics.aoe: Use Earthquake and Seismic Tremor across several targets to produce Crag interactions, then add Eruption and Journey to the Core at level 50; mid-level AoE reports are mixed.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Seismic spells are instant choices, but interruption, silence, pushback, or movement can break Earthshaping uptime and sharply reduce the stone-spam engine.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Stoneskin, the Primalist rage heal, slows, knock effects, and Golem Form provide survival, though current solo players report damage falling when enemies reach them.
mechanics.group_utility: Terrasurge and earth debuffs can add physical amplification, while the base Primalist kit supplies healing and group tools.

failure_modes.text: Losing Earthshaping during silence, stun, pushback, or poor Seismic timing interrupts the entire proc and cast-speed engine.

enjoy_if.text: You want an earth caster with rapid filler and satisfying crit-proc eruptions rather than slow boulder casts.

You enjoy the spec's core cadence: maintain earthshaping by choosing the appropriate shared-cooldown seismic spell, cast rapid stoneshards while waiting for crag and related procs, then spend aligned windows on lithic lance, terrasurge, golem form, or later eruption and geomolding.

avoid_if.text: You dislike maintaining a timed state or losing output to pushback and interruption.

You dislike the positioning or swap constraint that seismic spells are instant choices, but interruption, silence, pushback, or movement can break earthshaping uptime and sharply reduce the stone-spam engine.

praise.theme: Players praise the earthbender fantasy, rapid Stoneshard spam, and explosive Lithic Lance or landslide proc chains.

frustrations.theme: Pushback, Earthshaping upkeep, crit reliance, and inconsistent mid-level AoE are the recurring cautions.

contested.theme: Some players call it beginner-friendly while experienced reports describe meaningful uptime and proc management; the basic cast loop and optimized loop differ.

gaps: No current Build Hub build was captured.

Players disagree on AoE strength and report strong single target.
